title: ali ali hai ali ali hai
body:
quda ka pyara nabi ka dilbar ali ali hai ali ali hai
jaha'n ka hadi jina'n ka rehbar ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
iska sarmaya hai nabuwat wahi hai manqaahe ilm o hukmat
madina e qatmi maaab hyder ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo malike masnade mohammmad wo zeenate farshe qaabe ahmad
hai marziye haq ko naaz jis par ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ka ba'as kisi ka mubda kisi ka maawa kisi ka malja
kisi ka masja kisi ka masdar ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
nabuwat iski risalat iski imamat iski wilayat iski
qulasaye kainaate dawar ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo raaz bhi raazdaar bhi hai wo jaan bhi jaa'n nisaar bhi
madaare amre habeeb e dawar ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wasi bhi damaad bhi wali bhi wo zahir o batin nabi bhi
rasool ka tan rasool ka sar ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai uski seerat nabi ki seerat wo sar se taaba waj'he qudrat
kisi ka saani kisi ka mazhar ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bashar ka waali malak ka aaqa zamee'n ka maalik falak ka moula
kafeel e barzaq ameere meh'shar ali ali hai ali ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ba ghour jisne ali ko dekha mohammad e hashmi ko dekha
nabi ka parda nabi ka mehzar ali ali hai ali ali hai
